name: Mason
source:
Taciturn chef Mason is full of contradictions- she seems like she could take you in a fight, but also like she’d spoil you with pastries. Can you become sweethearts with this sweets maker?

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/datenighto/hustle-cat-a-visual-novel-about-a-magical-cat-cafe]Kickstarter[/url]]

[spoiler]Mason is an "adept," someone who is born with magic related to a trait rather than their magic being formed based on their life circumstances and personality. She has fire magic.[/spoiler]
